environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application on EKS 1.28 with MySQL 8.0. Cluster enforces Pod Security Standards at 'restricted' profile via namespace label (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). Pods cannot run as root, cannot mount hostPath volumes, and must drop ALL capabilities. The application pod runs as UID 1000 with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. Ephemeral storage for /tmp is an emptyDir with 100Mi limit. The MySQL connection is proxied through a sidecar (Cloud SQL Auth Proxy pattern) that enforces prepared-statement-only mode via ProxySQL with mysql-query_rules matching 'whereRaw|orderByRaw|selectRaw' patterns routed to a query_processor that rejects non-parameterized statements. Network policy restricts egress from app pod to only the ProxySQL sidecar on port 6033; direct MySQL access on 3306 is blocked by Cilium L4 policy.
